note: What the emulator caught while the templates were being written (2026-11-16, AWS Emulator 1.0.385). cfn-lint passed every template each time.

findings.cause: Pinned minor version not in the emulator's catalogue (16.3 and 16.4 only)
findings.fix: EngineVersion "16": RDS picks and upgrades the minor version (created 16.4)

findings.message: Value 'r7g.large.search' at 'clusterConfig.instanceType' failed to satisfy constraint
findings.cause: The emulator's OpenSearch model has no r7g instance types

findings.message: Invalid request provided: expected number, got string
findings.cause: The emulator's CloudFormation passes a value from a Number parameter or a mapping to OpenSearch as a string; literals and !If of literals work

findings.message: ROLLBACK_FAILED: Cannot delete protected DB Instance, please disable deletion protection and try again
findings.cause: A failed first create rolls back by deleting what it made; deletion protection blocks it and the stack is stuck. Real AWS behaves the same way
findings.fix: None needed in the template; the deploy script reports it, and the recovery is to disable protection on the orphaned instance and delete the stack

findings.message: CREATE_COMPLETE, but ElastiCache has no such replication group or subnet group
findings.cause: The emulator's CloudFormation reports ElastiCache resources (replication group and serverless cache alike) as created without creating them; ElastiCache called directly creates them
findings.fix: None in the template. infra.py inventory and verify report it; the app stack gets a placeholder cache address

findings.cause: The emulator's CloudFormation returns no value for this attribute although RDS created the secret
findings.fix: The app stack takes the secret ARN as a parameter; the deployer reads it from the data stack's output, or from RDS where the output is empty

findings.message: The RDS-managed secret is encrypted with aws/secretsmanager, not the data key
findings.cause: The emulator's CloudFormation ignores MasterUserSecret.KmsKeyId; RDS called directly honours MasterUserSecretKmsKeyId
findings.fix: None in the template; verify reports it as blocked by the emulator

findings.cause: Same as the OpenSearch volume: a Number parameter (AppPort) passed on as a string
findings.fix: Port 8090 as a literal; it is fixed by the image anyway

findings.cause: An export whose value is empty cannot be imported, even from the branch of an !If that is not taken
findings.fix: Pass the two values as parameters (see the DatabaseSecretArn finding)

findings.message: Stack is in ROLLBACK_COMPLETE state and can not be updated
findings.cause: A stack whose first create failed can only be deleted. Real AWS behaves the same way
findings.fix: infra.py deletes such a stack before creating it again

findings.message: operation ListBackupPlans is scaffolded but not implemented in this emulator
findings.fix: verify reads the plan by the ID the stack reports

findings.message: NotImplemented: this emulator does not change the properties of an existing AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition in place
findings.cause: On AWS a changed task definition becomes a new revision; the emulator does not do that update
findings.fix: Going live changes only the service and its scaling; new images (and so new revisions) are the CI/CD episode's job

findings.cause: DesiredCount and MinCapacity/MaxCapacity from Number parameters (MinTasks, MaxTasks)
findings.fix: Capacity profiles: Small (1 to 3 tasks) and Production (2 to 10) with literal numbers chosen by conditions

findings.message: Drift detection reports IN_SYNC after 5432 was opened to 0.0.0.0/0 by hand
findings.cause: The emulator's drift detection did not report the added ingress rule
findings.fix: None; reported as a drill result

findings.cause: The template asks for major version 16; RDS runs 16.4. Asking for a major version keeps the template valid as minor versions are retired, at the cost of this comparison
